name: הִלֵּל
summary: Hillel the Pirathonite, of Ephraim, father of Abdon who judged Israel eight years after Elon (Jdg 12:13–15). The name has the form of the piel perfect of הָלַל, “he has praised”, the same form as Psa 10:3 (הִלֵּל); scripture does not say who is the subject.

evidence.note: “After him Abdon son of הִלֵּל the Pirathonite judged Israel.”
“Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim.”
The same form הִלֵּל, the piel perfect “he has praised” (there “boasts”).

note: Takes e.bp.ab (2 tokens; the brief's piel token Psa 10:3 is the verb, filed here by spelling). The meaning rests on the form alone.
